destination.title: EFT consistency and information across scales
destination.question: Under specified physical principles or UV constructions, what constrains effective interactions, their validity scales and the microscopic information recoverable from them?
destination.summary: Most candidates concern amplitude constraints, causal consistency, coefficient inference or gravitational UV constructions. Cutting identities and gravitational flux collimation are adjacent questions; brane resolution, Born diagnostics and general EFT surveys need additional homes. Different systems and methods can share this family without sharing a fine question or common premises.

systems: Scalar, spinning-particle, photon and Standard Model EFTs
Selected supersymmetric, cosmological and holographic settings
targets: Necessary coefficient restrictions and their limitations
UV interaction information and matching degeneracies
Conditional gravitational, thermodynamic and information-based comparisons
regimes: Source-specific massive, massless, Lorentz-breaking and gravitational regimes
Specified perturbative, numerical and RG truncations
assumptions: Each contribution retains its own analyticity, unitarity, symmetry, growth and infrared assumptions
Quantum-gravity conjectures are comparison criteria, not shared established premises
Necessary consistency conditions do not establish existence or uniqueness of a UV completion
conventions: Source-specific coefficient normalizations, polarization bases and external states remain distinct
Fine singleton status retains the exact source question and does not establish atomicity or cross-source uniqueness
includes: Inverse inference, explicit UV matching and tests of the assumptions behind bounds
Adjacent diagnostic methods through explicitly qualified mappings
excludes: A universal positivity condition applying to every candidate
Automatic identification of tree-level unitarity violation with new particles
Treating Bell violation, a Born divergence or conjecture disagreement as an established UV obstruction

sources.title: Energy's and amplitudes' positivity

evidence.text: Can a higher-derivative scalar EFT support stable, isotropic NEC violation with luminal fluctuations and positive scattering amplitudes, and can such a theory admit a local Lorentz-invariant ultraviolet completion?

sources.title: Softness and amplitudes’ positivity for spinning particles

evidence.text: Can forward-amplitude positivity be extended to particles of arbitrary spin, including fermions, and what does it imply for the maximum softness of interacting EFT amplitudes and approximate supersoft theories?

sources.title: Positivity bounds for scalar field theories

evidence.text: Which positivity conditions must a massive scalar EFT satisfy if it admits a local, analytic, unitary, Poincaré-invariant UV completion, including away from forward scattering? Can these conditions also bound the mass threshold of additional states?

sources.title: Improved Positivity Bounds and Massive Gravity

evidence.text: Under standard Wilsonian UV-completion assumptions, can massive Galileons and massive gravity satisfy improved positivity bounds while retaining a controlled Vainshtein regime, and what coupling and cutoff hierarchies follow?

sources.title: A Tower Weak Gravity Conjecture from Infrared Consistency

evidence.text: Can photon causality and S-matrix analyticity constrain charged spectra in multiple-U(1) EFTs, and can consistency after circle compactification motivate a tower version of the WGC?

sources.title: Higher-Point Positivity

evidence.text: How do analyticity, causality, and spectral unitarity constrain higher-point derivative operators, and how are those constraints related to energy conditions and the Legendre transform?

sources.title: To Positivity and Beyond, where Higgs-Dilaton Inflation has never gone before

evidence.text: Do forward-amplitude positivity and improved positivity constrain the first higher-derivative Wilson coefficients of Higgs-Dilaton inflation strongly enough to conflict with its phenomenological parameter region?

sources.title: Consistency of the Standard Model Effective Field Theory

evidence.text: What necessary restrictions do analytic, unitary forward scattering and causal propagation impose on dimension-eight bosonic SMEFT couplings, including CP violation, and how can these restrictions inform experimental interpretation?

sources.title: Convex Geometry Perspective on the (Standard Model) Effective Field Theory Space

evidence.text: Can the convex geometry of forward-amplitude EFT data identify necessary UV states and their couplings, and yield coefficient bounds stronger than elastic positivity from independently superposed external states?

sources.title: New positivity bounds from full crossing symmetry

evidence.text: How much more can partial-wave unitarity and full crossing symmetry constrain scalar EFT Wilson coefficients than positivity of absorptive-part derivatives alone?

sources.title: Positivity bounds without boosts: New constraints on low energy effective field theories from the UV

evidence.text: Which positivity constraints on low-energy scalar scattering survive broken Lorentz boosts, and what do they imply for superfluids, inflationary non-Gaussianity, and the scale where additional physics or nonperturbative effects become necessary?

sources.title: Into the EFThedron and UV constraints from IR consistency

evidence.text: How can the dispersive space of EFT Wilson coefficients be characterized through moment geometry, and what restrictions does IR crossing symmetry impose on UV spins, spectral weights and masses?

sources.title: QFT, EFT and GFT

evidence.text: How can geometric function theory constrain low-energy 2-to-2 scattering coefficients, explain finite allowed coefficient regions, and accommodate bound-state or massless poles?

sources.title: Asymptotic Safety: Swampland or Wonderland?

evidence.text: Which infrared gravitational Wilson coefficients arise from asymptotically safe RG trajectories, and how does their allowed region intersect the weak gravity, de Sitter and trans-Planckian censorship conjectures?

sources.title: Triple crossing positivity bounds for multi-field theories

evidence.text: How can full crossing symmetry and multi-field unitarity optimally constrain higher-order EFT scattering coefficients, including odd-power inelastic terms, and when are their allowed regions finite?

sources.title: Entropy constraints on effective field theory

evidence.text: Can relative entropy between theories with and without heavy–light interactions constrain EFT Wilson coefficients and establish conditional connections between entropy corrections and shifts of extremality?

sources.title: Snowmass White Paper: UV Constraints on IR Physics

evidence.text: Which low-energy EFTs admit consistent UV completions, and how do QFT principles, holography and conjectured quantum-gravity requirements constrain their Wilson coefficients?

sources.title: Spinning sum rules for the dimension-six SMEFT

evidence.text: Which dimension-six SMEFT Wilson-coefficient signs encode the dominant angular momentum of UV states, and how do beyond-forward dispersion relations and poles at infinity delimit that inference?

sources.title: Effective field theory in light of relative entropy

evidence.text: What constraints on heavy-field corrections and EFT Wilson coefficients follow from relative entropy between a target theory and different reference theories, and how do these relate to thermodynamic inequalities and WGC-like behavior?

sources.title: Constraints on Regge behavior from IR physics

evidence.text: What constraints do crossing symmetry, analyticity and unitarity impose on gravitational EFT coefficients, and how does infrared physics constrain the ultraviolet Regge trajectory and residue?

sources.title: Positivity and the electroweak hierarchy

evidence.text: Can positivity connect an unnatural hierarchy among higher-dimensional EFT coefficients to a restricted Higgs vev relative to the cutoff, and could future experiments identify such a pattern?

sources.title: Effective field theory bootstrap, large-N χPT and holographic QCD

evidence.text: Can dispersive and S-matrix EFT bootstraps be formulated as primal/dual SDPs, converge for large-N pion scattering, reveal extremal UV spectra, and constrain higher-derivative holographic QCD?

sources.title: Unearthing the intersections: positivity bounds, weak gravity conjecture, and asymptotic safety landscapes from photon-graviton flows

evidence.text: Which low-energy photon–graviton EFTs arise from asymptotically safe RG trajectories, and how do their Wilson coefficients compare with scattering positivity, black-hole entropy positivity and a higher-derivative electric WGC condition?

sources.title: Matching the Vilkovisky–DeWitt Effective Action of Quantum Gravity to String Theory

evidence.text: How can the Vilkovisky–DeWitt gravitational effective action be matched to string compactifications to determine local Wilson coefficients, connect them to low-energy observables, and interpret their species dependence?

sources.title: Laplacians in various dimensions and the swampland

evidence.text: Can differential equations for protected higher-curvature Wilson coefficients constrain the species cutoff and its infinite-distance convex hull, and when is the relevant elliptic operator the scalar Laplacian?

sources.title: Thermal Positivity

evidence.text: Can zero-temperature scattering-amplitude positivity impose sign constraints on interaction corrections to pressure, free energy, entropy and specific heat, despite the thermal state's loss of Lorentz invariance?

sources.title: Causality, analyticity and an IR obstruction to UV completion

evidence.text: Can apparently consistent, local, Lorentz-invariant low-energy EFTs be excluded from conventional UV completion by signs of leading irrelevant interactions, and what infrared pathology accompanies that obstruction?

sources.title: Energy's and amplitudes' positivity

evidence.text: Extract the effective metric from the quadratic fluctuation kinetic operator and analyze its characteristic cone. Weak static vacuum backgrounds satisfy Laplace's equation; a local Taylor expansion yields a traceless spatial Hessian controlling the cone shift.

sources.title: Softness and amplitudes’ positivity for spinning particles

evidence.text: Analytically continues pure-state density matrices contracted with amputated correlators. CPT and polarization relations make forward crossing act as s↔u, with charge conjugation and helicity reversal; fermionic statistics signs are compensated by polarization behavior.

sources.title: Positivity bounds for scalar field theories

evidence.text: Derivatives of the pole-subtracted amplitude are expressed through positive spectral moments I(q,p). Inequalities comparing successive moments control the alternating signs introduced by t derivatives, allowing recursive construction of positive combinations Y(2N,M).

sources.title: Improved Positivity Bounds and Massive Gravity

evidence.text: Improve the bounds by subtracting the calculable absorptive integral from threshold 4m² to ε²Λ², leaving a positive high-energy remainder. Forward helicity bounds include both direct and crossed total cross sections; crossing reverses the relevant helicity sign.

sources.title: A Tower Weak Gravity Conjecture from Infrared Consistency

evidence.text: Integrate out massive matter using the one-loop heat-kernel expansion. Leading equations of motion and field redefinitions convert curvature corrections into F⁴ operators in 3D; a Weyl-tensor–F² operator also remains in 4D.

sources.title: Higher-Point Positivity

evidence.text: Expand around a constant-gradient condensate ∂μφ=wμ, derive the effective fluctuation metric, and impose subluminal propagation together with background energy and stability requirements.

sources.title: The EFT-Hedron

evidence.text: What constraints do causality, unitarity, analyticity and locality impose on the infinite higher-derivative expansion of four-particle amplitudes, including relations beyond forward-limit coefficient positivity?

sources.title: Impact of Quantum Gravity on the UV Sensitivity of Extremal Black Holes

evidence.text: Can Wilson coefficients selected by asymptotically safe quantum gravity prevent divergent horizon tidal forces in EFT-corrected extremal Kerr black holes, and how does that conclusion depend on the quantum-gravity transition scale?

sources.title: Rigorous bounds on light-by-light scattering

evidence.text: Which four-dimensional photon EFTs are compatible with unitary, Lorentz-invariant UV scattering, and what two-sided bounds follow for four-, six-, and eight-derivative coefficients?

sources.title: Consistency analysis of a CPT-even and CPT-odd Lorentz-violating effective field theory in the electrodynamics at Planck scale by an influence of a background isotropic field

evidence.text: Can quadratic Lorentz-violating photon operators of arbitrary mass dimension be organized into CPT-even and CPT-odd towers, and which isotropic models satisfy the authors' stability, causality and tree-level unitarity tests?

sources.title: Infrared-Finite Positivity Bounds in 4D Gravity

evidence.text: Can a scattering problem with geometric infrared control yield finite gravitational positivity bounds on local four-scalar Wilson coefficients while controlling both low-energy exchange and the full UV absorptive spectrum?

sources.title: Superluminality and UV completion

evidence.text: Does a consistent UV completion impose positivity constraints on leading irrelevant operators through causality, particularly when a low-energy theory has superluminal phase velocity and gravity may participate in its completion?

sources.title: Self-healing of unitarity in effective field theories and the onset of new physics

evidence.text: Does violation of tree-level partial-wave unitarity locate new degrees of freedom, or can an effective theory restore elastic unitarity internally before new physics becomes accessible? Is significant inelasticity a better diagnostic?

sources.title: UV complete me: Positivity Bounds for Particles with Spin

evidence.text: Which necessary inequalities must massive-particle EFT amplitudes satisfy to admit a standard local, unitary, analytic, Lorentz-invariant UV completion, including arbitrary spins and polarizations away from forward scattering?

sources.title: Bell inequalities in 2-2 scattering

evidence.text: Can Bell parameters distinguish theories in elastic 2-to-2 scattering and constrain EFT coefficients by locating boundaries between Bell-violating and nonviolating theories?

sources.title: String theory from maximal supersymmetry

evidence.text: How strongly do maximal supersymmetry, unbroken R-symmetry, higher-point tree factorization, and a six-scalar parity condition constrain four-point EFT Wilson coefficients? With additional dispersive positivity assumptions, do those constraints isolate the open-superstring Veneziano amplitude?

sources.title: The double EFT expansion in quantum gravity

evidence.text: How do higher-curvature corrections distinguish the breakdown of a particular gravitational EFT from the breakdown of local gravitational EFT altogether, and what constraints does this distinction place on Wilson coefficients?

sources.title: The String landscape, black holes and gravity as the weakest force

evidence.text: Which signs of photon self-interactions are compatible with the stated causality and scattering assumptions?

sources.title: Bell violation in 2 → 2 scattering in photon, gluon and graviton EFTs

evidence.text: Can 2→2 scattering produce final-state Bell violation from initial helicity states satisfying |I2i|≤2, constrain EFT coefficients when the input is a product state, or diagnose CP violation using a maximally entangled input?

sources.title: Positivity in the renormalization of effective field theory

evidence.text: Which one-loop EFT renormalization contributions have a definite sign using only infrared principles, and when does that sign preserve tree-level forward positivity bounds or permit their apparent violation?

sources.title: Superluminality, black holes and EFT

evidence.text: Assuming a UV theory forbids superluminal signaling, when can apparent EFT superluminality produce an accumulated advance larger than the EFT's resolving distance, and what would that imply for its cutoff?

sources.title: Bounds on photon scattering

evidence.text: Which low-energy photon-scattering Wilson coefficients admit nonperturbative bounds from full nonlinear unitarity, which bounds follow from positivity, and which directions remain unbounded?

sources.title: Reverse Bootstrapping: IR Lessons for UV Physics

evidence.text: Can calculable infrared Standard Model photon–graviton scattering constrain ultraviolet gravitational amplitudes through gravitational positivity bounds, thereby reversing their usual interpretation as constraints on EFT coefficients?

sources.title: Positivity bounds in vector theories

evidence.text: What restrictions do standard UV-completion assumptions place on parity-even Generalized Proca and Proca-Nuevo interactions, particularly when scalar-vector mixing, indefinite polarizations and bounds beyond the forward limit are included?

sources.title: Causality bounds on scalar-tensor EFTs

evidence.text: How do dispersive causality bounds restrict scalar-tensor Wilson coefficients, especially scalar–Gauss–Bonnet interactions, when full crossing relations and the massless graviton t-channel pole are retained?

sources.title: Snowmass Theory Frontier: Effective Field Theory

evidence.text: What recent advances and future opportunities make EFT useful for precision predictions across physics, and how do ultraviolet consistency and naturalness constrain its construction and possible breakdown?

sources.title: SMEFTs living on the edge: determining the UV theories from positivity and extremality

evidence.text: How much UV interaction information can exact dimension-8 SMEFT coefficients determine despite intrinsic matching degeneracies, and why do points on or near positivity boundaries permit stronger reconstruction?
